verdict.rationale: The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at developer.atlassian.com/llms.txt), and no evidence describes agent-oriented documentation for Jira. The published OpenAPI spec and the official MCP server are related but separate capabilities: a machine-readable API spec and a tool server are not docs written for agents to read, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
